allowed_scope: Exact-byte transport, one new tiny synthetic CPU gate and metadata freeze only. Actual pretrained model, QA capture, SVD/fitting on real weights, DEV generation and activation require a separate admission based on the resulting evidence.
findings: Carrier retains only original gate/down and act_fn plus new thin left/right and optional row_scale parameters. No original up module is retained. The same single gate projection result is used by both the nonlinear gate and the Reuse value path.

Initialization is rowwise U/G regression with declared denominator clamp and FP32 residual SVD. Actual fitting now installs FP32 masters directly, freezes the overall model and enables only the current layer factors/d; it does not round to FP16 and then promote before fitting.

Selection uses the fixed original FIT IDs, known groups and deterministic representatives: first32 fit and next16 check. Capture follows the original answer_loss target policy, samples at most64 fixed positions, checks projected payload before CPU allocation, and interrupts after the last MLP hook before the output head.

Both arms load the same sealed sampled x/h and use the same 4-epoch/128-state/constant-LR normalized complete-block MSE. Held features are observations only. Durable per-update records support actual optimizer steps, finite parameters/gradients, coordinate counts and CPU moment bytes.

The final factors/d are cast to FP16. The complete package contains the actual compact state, and a freshly constructed factorized architecture strictly reloads it; layouts and full parameter/buffer digests must match before generation and remain unchanged during generation.

The copied parent is bound to the fixed existing VERIFIED, its COMPLETE, initialization digest, parent prediction SHA and old READY. Historical runtime/processor sources are checked, and every new evaluation input digest, ID/reference and generation cap must match the original parent record.

The unique verifier now uses original token_f1 for both new arms, consistent with copied parent F1. It runs only after all three COMPLETE/successful exits, requires fixed mandatory file sets, exact fitting schedules, physical layouts/package metadata, resource PID and terminal phase, and full 100-ID/5-domain coverage.

The controller and worker require a separate model-admission review bound to READY. The controller selects one genuinely free OLD GPU, retains it across phases, applies independent 1200/2400/2400 deadlines, and signals only identity-confirmed own isolated process groups.

The tiny source exercises one gate call, explicit carrier arithmetic, nonzero finite training gradients with frozen originals, four updates, absence of up keys, actual serialization and strict whole-Qwen reload. No real model or data was executed in this review.
resolved_findings: Replaced accidental rougeL lookup with token_f1; no old score was modified or rerun.
Aligned worker initialization with the declared FP32-master path and the tiny gate.
Added exact required init/arm file sets, resource start/end/PID, fitting-summary/schedule and final checkpoint metadata validation.
Final package SHA is retained after the actual save and reused for COMPLETE generation rather than immediately hashing the same package again.
limitations: This is source acceptance, not an executed CPU gate or model admission. No Torch import, module execution, QA, model, score or bootstrap was performed by this reviewer.
CPU FP32 gate success cannot validate actual CUDA FP16 numerical stability, large-model time/memory, or answering quality.

Complete coefficient counts remain expectations until real layouts are checked. Reuse is21504 coefficients smaller than Static; the comparison is near-matched, not exact-budget or isolated optimization causality.
Keeping G/down does not prove semantic correspondence or preservation of actual gates after upstream changes. Fit/check positions are correlated states, not additional independent images.
Local held-feature MSE cannot authorize continuing. The real reloaded whole-model F1 must satisfy Reuse>Static macro and the fixed five-domain unadapted-parent floor.
Input/digest binding failure stops rather than silently replacing or rescoring the parent reference. Do not restore old compressed checkpoints or trajectories.

One explored DEV seed is not a stability/equivalence/significance or novelty claim. A positive compact starting point would require a separate subsequent adaptation decision; first failure closes the present point without search.
